$comment: The open-call record contract. Enforced by scripts/build-registry.mjs, which is the only validator — there is no JSON Schema runtime in this repository and no dependency is added for one.
id: kebab-case, unique, stable. Renaming an id breaks nothing but loses the record's identity across commits.

notes.date_basis: confirmed means a human opened `source` and read the date off it on the day recorded in `verified`. estimated means the date is a placeholder derived from the programme's usual cycle and MUST NOT be relied on. The Vantage module marks every estimated date in the interface.
notes.verified: ISO date a human last checked this record against `source`, or null if never. A null `verified` forces `register` to V.
notes.register: O observed in this repository, D documented against a named source, I inferred, V unverified. Same register marks the README uses.
notes.award: min/max may be null when the programme does not publish a figure. `basis` follows the same rule as date_basis.
notes.stage: The workflow stage this record currently sits in. Must be a stage id declared in data/workflow.json. The engine owns every transition out of it.
